method: Historical event candidates with official references. Dates and legal categories must be rechecked before influence assessment; no automatic positive or negative scores.

cases.event: U.S. presidential memorandum directed withdrawal as a TPP signatory; TPP had not entered into force.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure diverted trade and partner policy changes; do not assume Chinese gain.

cases.event: India announced expeditious disengagement of border personnel at Doklam.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Independent verification of force positions and sustained changes in border access.

cases.event: United States announced withdrawal from UN Human Rights Council.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Measure lost or gained voting influence, participation and reforms against counterfactual.

cases.event: United States, Mexico and Canada signed USMCA; entry into force occurred July 1, 2020.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Compare trade patterns, investment, wages, costs and policy concessions.

cases.event: INF Treaty ended following U.S. withdrawal and allegations of Russian noncompliance, disputed by Russia.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Independently attribute security consequences, deployments and arms-control costs.

cases.event: United Kingdom formally withdrew from the European Union.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Separate EU diplomatic leverage from UK sovereignty, economic and institutional changes.

cases.event: United States and China signed Phase One economic and trade agreement.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Compare purchasing commitments with realized trade, external shocks and costs.

cases.event: Deadly Galwan Valley clash amid border tensions; not classified here as a legally adjudicated treaty breach.
cases.outcomeNeeded: Assess verified casualties, disengagement and durable changes to bilateral ties.
